item.title: Superhero Birthday Scavenger Hunt for Kids, Printable and Personalized
item.description: A superhero treasure hunt made for your child: rhyming clue cards for the hiding spots in your own home, a mission briefing to read aloud and a finisher certificate. Print at home in minutes, great for birthday parties and rainy days. Ages 2 to 8.
